newsitem.title: TURKEY: Tupras buys 25kt gas oil, 50kt gasoline in tender.
newsitem.headline: Tupras buys 25kt gas oil, 50kt gasoline in tender.

text.p: Turkey's state oil refinery Tupras awarded on Monday a tender under which it will buy 25,000 tonnes of gas oil from Tempo, 25,000 tonnes of gasoline from Glencore and another 25,000 tonnes of gasoline from Vitol.

The company said in a statement that the Tempo deal was priced at a premium of plus $10.64 per tonne. The gasoline deals with Glencore and Vitol were at discounts of $8.15 and $8.30 a tonne, respectively.

The delivery from Tempo is scheduled for May 8-12, those from Glencore and Vitol for May 8-10, it said. All deliveries will be made to Izmit port. All prices are based off fob Mediterranean basis Italy quotations. The tender was held on April 17.
